newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: FCL Forests cautiously optimistic.
newsitem.headline: FCL Forests cautiously optimistic.

text.p: Fletcher Forests said on Wednesday it was cautiously optimistic about the future prospects for log prices.

"We are cautiously optmistic that overall price levels will be higher in the coming year than in the past year. Inventories are now at manageable levels in all key markets and a stronger Japanese economy is anticipated by mid year, which should boost plywood, Douglas fir and laminated product prices," FCL Forests chief executive Paul Fowler said.

"In reality we have little influence over commodity prices, so management's focus will be on aggressively pursuing our strategy and short-term performance improvements, and capturing the benefits of our new organisation in processing and in forest operations."
Fowler said the company would review its processing structure to try and match its ahrvest profile with customer demand for solidwood products.
Earlier, the company reported a June year net profit of NZ$153 million, up from $74 million.
